name: AI Readiness Accelerator Solution Pack
description: Package the complete AI AuthoriTech readiness engagement into a repeatable consulting offer that turns organizational evidence into prioritized, governed, economically grounded AI implementation decisions.
business_outcome: Give leaders a defensible decision package showing where AI fits, what must be fixed first, what to implement, what it should cost, how value will be measured, and how delivery will be governed.
target_customers: public-sector teams requiring a separate government overlay
implementation_model: A gated consulting engagement delivered through intake, evidence collection, stakeholder discovery, readiness assessment, workflow analysis, opportunity and governance review, economic modeling, roadmap validation, and optional implementation contracting.
success_measures: decision-makers approve or reject opportunities using traceable evidence
priority initiatives have owners, gates, measures, and dependencies
proposal and statement of work match the approved roadmap
unsupported claims and false precision are absent
client receives a usable next-step plan
support_model: AI AuthoriTech facilitates the engagement, maintains the evidence and decision trail, conducts quality review, and offers separately authorized implementation, training, and quarterly reassessment support.
